description: Cycle4 Lang-coll regression queries for Java List interface order/duplicates/index, Queue interface operations, BlockingQueue producer-consumer handoff, and standard functional interfaces.

queries.prompt: 자바에서 입력된 순서가 의미 있고 같은 값도 두 번 들어갈 수 있는 목록은 왜 List로 표현해?
queries.reformulated_query: Java List interface ordered collection duplicate elements index positional access beginner
queries.notes: Should retrieve the focused List interface contract, not only the broader List/Set/Map chooser.

queries.prompt: List의 ordered가 sort 완료 상태를 뜻하는지 헷갈려. 원소 위치랑 0번 index 관점으로 풀어줘
queries.reformulated_query: List ordered means element sequence positional index not sorted comparator order
queries.notes: Distinguishes List ordered/index contract from advanced comparator/order map semantics.

queries.prompt: 작업 대기열에 넣거나 꺼낼 때 add 대신 offer, remove 대신 poll을 쓰는 기준이 뭐야?
queries.reformulated_query: Java Queue add offer remove poll element peek exception special value empty capacity beginner
queries.notes: Queue method-pair contract should win over BlockingQueue producer-consumer details.

queries.prompt: Queue 인터페이스에서 FIFO 구현과 PriorityQueue처럼 head 기준이 다른 구현의 ordering policy를 어떻게 읽어?
queries.reformulated_query: Queue head ordering policy FIFO PriorityQueue implementation contract head tail
queries.notes: Targets the Java Queue interface ordering-policy contract rather than a concrete FIFO implementation chooser.

queries.prompt: BlockingQueue에서 producer가 put으로 넣고 consumer가 take로 꺼내면 어느 쪽이 언제 멈춰?
queries.reformulated_query: BlockingQueue producer consumer put take bounded queue waits when full empty backpressure
queries.notes: Should retrieve the producer-consumer put/take primer before the advanced TransferQueue/ConcurrentSkipListSet comparison.

queries.prompt: BlockingQueue consumer를 멈출 때 close 메서드 대신 poison pill 종료 토큰과 interrupt 처리를 어떻게 나눠?
queries.reformulated_query: BlockingQueue shutdown poison pill interrupt multiple consumers no close protocol
queries.notes: Focuses on BlockingQueue shutdown protocol, not lower-level wait/notify condition mechanics.

queries.prompt: Predicate는 참거짓 판정, Function은 값 변환, Consumer는 사용, Supplier는 지연 생성으로 읽으면 돼?
queries.reformulated_query: java.util.function Predicate Function Consumer Supplier choose by boolean transform consume supply
queries.notes: Should retrieve the standard functional interface chooser, not only the broader lambda/SAM bridge.

queries.prompt: filter는 Predicate, map은 Function, forEach는 Consumer, orElseGet은 Supplier처럼 target type이 달라?
queries.reformulated_query: Stream filter map forEach Optional orElseGet Predicate Function Consumer Supplier target type
queries.notes: Targets API target types Predicate/Function/Consumer/Supplier rather than general stream/lambda basics.
